messages:
zoe: quick review: tightened pool row to hit 48px. added compact min/max icons, Burst badge that opens a tiny popover for minutes. prototype: https://redwood.design/s/compact-v3 :eyes:
ashley: looks good. two quick asks: 1) microcopy for Burst in the badge (short), 2) ensure steppers are keyboard friendly.
kevin: copy option: 'Burst • short (mins)' or just 'Burst (mins)'. tooltip: 'Add temporary GPUs for spikes. Billing while active.'
liam: a11y: steppers need aria-labels like 'Increase min for pool web-prod'. when popover opens move focus to minutes input. also add aria-live for value changes.
ashley: (typo) meant to say thanks liam. agree on focus. Also contrast: burst badge text should be #062e6b on #f3f6fb background to meet 4.5:1.
ashley: suggestion: show full copy in expanded state: 'Burst — add temporary capacity (up to 60 min)'. keep badge short in list.
zoe: implementation plan: badge + popover by default, inline expanded when card is opened. action items: Ashley to push two visual states, Kevin to finalize tooltip text, Liam to add aria snippets. UX-bot will re-run density check. deadline: Tue EOD.
ux-bot: density check scheduled 2026-04-06T09:00Z and will post results here.
